translation: All glories, all glories to the meeting of the transcendental couple, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. The gopīs headed by Lalitā Devī perform the ceremony of Their worship.
Kṛṣṇa is the attractor of Cupid, and His beautiful form is bending in three places. He wears yellow garments and a charming peacock-feather crown.
Dressed in blue garments, Her complexion fair, and Her virtues glorious, King Vṛṣabhānu’s daughter, Śrīmatī Rādhikā is on the left of the charming Lord Mādhava.
Her various ornaments sparkle and Her effulgent face charms the heart of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
Viśākhā and the other girls sing songs in various tunes and moods as Kṛṣṇa’s intimate playful girlfriends fan the Divine Couple with whisks.
Yearning to attain the lotus feet of Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, Bhakti Vinod floats in happiness at the gopīs’ feet.
